title: Muscle map says 'Nothing trained' when the 30 or 90 day read fails
what: On Progress, picking '30 days' or '90 days' reads that range's sets. If the read fails, the error is only logged and the range is treated as empty, so the member sees 'Nothing trained in the last 90 days' and 'Do a workout...' even when they trained.
expected: A failed read says it could not load the map and offers to try again, never an empty-training message.
how_often: rare: only when the phone's database read fails
fix_line: Keep a failed state and show a load error with Try again
